# 🧠 CogniCare NER — Data Flow

**Project:** CogniCare NER
**Hackathon:** Smart India Hackathon 2026
**Document Owner:** Product + System Architect
**Status:** Architecture Baseline — SIH 2026 MVP

---

# 1. Purpose

This document defines how data moves through the CogniCare NER system.

It describes:

* Data generated by the patient
* Local data processing
* Offline storage
* Synchronization
* Backend processing
* AI/cognitive processing
* Caregiver dashboard data
* Reminder data
* Voice/language data
* Consent and authorization flow

The goal is to ensure that every development team understands:

> **What data they receive, what data they generate, and where that data goes next.**

---

# 2. High-Level Data Flow

The primary system data flow is:

```text
                    ┌─────────────────┐
                    │     PATIENT     │
                    └────────┬────────┘
                             │
                             ▼
                    ┌─────────────────┐
                    │  PATIENT APP   │
                    └────────┬────────┘
                             │
              ┌──────────────┼──────────────┐
              │              │              │
              ▼              ▼              ▼
           Games         Reminders        Voice
              │              │              │
              └──────────────┼──────────────┘
                             ▼
                    ┌─────────────────┐
                    │   LOCAL DB      │
                    │                 │
                    │ Sessions        │
                    │ Reminders       │
                    │ Sync Queue      │
                    └────────┬────────┘
                             │
                      Connectivity
                             │
                             ▼
                    ┌─────────────────┐
                    │  SYNC ENGINE    │
                    └────────┬────────┘
                             │
                             ▼
                    ┌─────────────────┐
                    │    BACKEND      │
                    └────────┬────────┘
                             │
                ┌────────────┼────────────┐
                │            │            │
                ▼            ▼            ▼
            DATABASE      AI ENGINE   AUTH/CONSENT
                │            │
                │            ▼
                │       Recommendations
                │       Trends
                │       Alerts
                │
                └────────────┬────────────
                             ▼
                    ┌─────────────────┐
                    │    CAREGIVER    │
                    │    DASHBOARD    │
                    └─────────────────┘
```

---

# 3. Data Ownership

Each subsystem has primary responsibility for particular data.

| Data                      | Primary Owner            |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| Patient UI state          | Patient App              |
| Game state                | Patient App              |
| Local game results        | Local DB                 |
| Sync queue                | Patient App / Sync Layer |
| Server game sessions      | Backend / Database       |
| Patient account           | Backend                  |
| Caregiver account         | Backend                  |
| Consent                   | Backend                  |
| Reminder records          | Backend + Local DB       |
| Performance metrics       | Backend / Database       |
| Difficulty recommendation | AI Engine                |
| Performance trend         | AI Engine                |
| Caregiver presentation    | Caregiver Dashboard      |
| Language content          | Voice Content Packs      |
| Authentication state      | Authentication Layer     |

No module should silently become the owner of another module's data.

---

# 4. Patient Registration / Authentication Flow

The patient first establishes an authenticated application session.

```text
Patient
   │
   ▼
Open App
   │
   ▼
Login / Registration
   │
   ▼
Authentication
   │
   ▼
Backend
   │
   ├── Validate credentials
   │
   └── Return authentication result
   │
   ▼
Patient App
   │
   ▼
Store required session state securely
```

The patient application should not store unnecessary authentication information.

---

# 5. Patient Profile Flow

Patient profile information is retrieved from the backend when required.

```text
Patient App
    │
    │ GET patient profile
    ▼
Backend
    │
    ▼
Databas
```
